sources.title: GitHub - sgawad/trellis2-rocm: rocm patches on Trellis2
sources.snippet: Get Microsoft TRELLIS2 (image-to-3D AI) running on an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo / gfx1151) under Windows 11 + WSL2, using ROCm 7.2. This repo collects every patch, workaround, and build script needed to make it work.

sources.title: Fine-tuning LLMs on AMD GPUs with Unsloth Guide
sources.snippet: Fine-tune LLMs up to 2x faster with ~70% less memory on AMD hardware, no NVIDIA required. Unsloth supports AMD Radeon RDNA 3/3.5/4 (RX 6000-9000 series) on both Windows and Linux as well as data center GPUs including the MI300X (192GB).
